input.command:
python3 -c '
# Let check if table is visible in obs_0001, obs_0002, or obs_0003:
# Table at (2.36, 1.53).
# From (0, 0), angle = atan2(x, y) = atan2(2.36, 1.53) = 57.0 degrees clockwise!
# In obs_0002, heading is 60.0 degrees!
# Let check obs_0002!
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
arr2 = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0002.png"))
# Brown table in obs_0002:
m = (arr2[:, :, 0] > 100) & (arr2[:, :, 0] < 180) & (arr2[:, :, 1] > 50) & (arr2[:, :, 1] < 100) & (arr2[:, :, 2] < 50)
y2, x2 = np.where(m)
print("Table in obs_0002: x range", x2.min(), x2.max(), "mean x", x2.mean(), "y range", y2.min(), y2.max())
'
